title: trace.active_driver_chain.request

render_time_unit.description: Controls only canonical response time rendering: auto, ps, ns, or us. It never changes input parsing, sampling, filtering, or ordering.

signal.description: Final leaf signal path. Aggregate, array, and struct roots are not expanded automatically.

time.description: Target sample time. Prefer a canonical string with a unit; a bare number is interpreted as nanoseconds.

value_format.description: 返回 LogicValue 的显示格式；不改变比较、采样或底层四态值。

max_depth.description: Maximum recursive depth of the active-driver chain.

max_trace_signals.description: Maximum candidate signals sampled for ambiguity evidence.

max_results.description: Maximum simplified chain evidence paths returned.

timeout_ms.description: Positive public frontend-to-engine request timeout in milliseconds. Omit limits.timeout_ms to disable the public watchdog.

description: Trace an active-driver chain across multiple levels.
x-how_it_works: 从 signal/time 递归追溯 active driver；value_format 支持 hex、bin、dec 并统一控制链上采样值显示，默认 hex；深度限制写 top-level limits.max_depth，默认 8。遇到多个 active assignments 或多个 RHS sources 时在精确 active_time 返回前后值证据并停止。因 max_depth 停止时读取 data.depth_frontiers 与 suggested_next_actions，可从 frontier 续查或提高深度重跑。
x-when_to_use: 给出跨级根因链及 ambiguous RHS 现场。
x-arg_contract_notes: required: signal, time; limits: max_depth(default 8), max_nodes(default 50), max_trace_signals(default 64); do not use args.depth, args.clk_period or limits.max_alias_candidates

use_when: 需要从指定 signal/time 递归展开单条 active-driver chain；limits.max_depth 默认 8。
do_not_use_when: 查询点是 X，且需要同时追踪多个 X RHS/control 分支。

alternatives.when: 需要按 X 可见性进行多分支追踪。

constraints: required: signal, time; limits: max_depth(default 8), max_nodes(default 50), max_trace_signals(default 64); do not use args.depth, args.clk_period or limits.max_alias_candidates
